newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Military L-39 crashes in Ukraine. two pilots dead.
newsitem.headline: Military L-39 crashes in Ukraine. two pilots dead.

text.p: A Ukrainian military L-39 jet has crashed during a test flight, killing two pilots, a Defence Ministry spokesman said on Thursday.
Andriy Lysenko told Reuters the Czech-made L-39 non-combat training plane crashed on Wednesday near the military airfield in the town of Uman, some 200 km (120 miles) south of the capital Kiev.
"A special investigation committee has been set up and will determine what caused the crash," said Lysenko, describing the two pilots as "extremely experienced".
Last year a military MiG-29 fighter went missing over the Black Sea, and efforts to find wreckage or the pilot were unsuccesful.
